scope: Symmetric F2 matrices with at least two successful full-length pressing sequences; uniform measure and inclusive one-third/two-thirds endpoints.
finite_result: No counterexample through order eight; exhaustive isomorphism-reduced coverage and exact counting independently checked.
structural_results: Exact partition by label-indexed instructional Cholesky roots
Adjacent-swap and successful one-letter-relocation components equal instructional classes
Self-contained uniform balance theorem for recursively constructed V-posets
Autonomous pressing corollary using explicitly named external Cooper–Gartland–Whitlatch characterization
Verified inaccessible, no-greedoid, no-single-poset, strict-endpoint and competing-first-pair controls
Necessary conditions on a vertex-minimal counterexample
external_theorem_not_fully_audited: Cooper–Gartland–Whitlatch autonomy characterization, arXiv:1810.07276v2, Theorems2–3. Source defects are narrowly identified without claiming a full repair/audit of the theorem.
not_claimed: Novelty or a literature-optimal finite bound
review_status: AI-assisted, unrefereed work. Acceptance means independent internal AI mathematical review within the stated scope, not external human peer review, journal acceptance, formal proof-assistant certification, priority clearance, or confirmation of a literature-optimal bound.
distribution: Complete authored mathematical prose and substantive audit, public citations and aggregate verification metadata. No executable public replay package.

factorization_supplement.scope: Nonsingular symmetric F2 matrices with nonempty full-length successful pressing families. Balance conclusions retain the nonunique-family hypothesis.
factorization_supplement.accepted_theorem: Variable-order components are uniquely ordered contiguous blocks, with full successful-word family exactly the Cartesian product of their nonsingular pressable principal Schur-complement families.
factorization_supplement.accepted_probability_consequence: Independent uniform component words; exact internal pair marginals; fixed cross-component precedence; delta(A)=max delta(B_i), with singleton delta zero.
factorization_supplement.combined_with_previously_accepted_finite: Every nonunique full-rank pressable matrix whose variable-order components have size at most eight has a balanced pair. Every vertex-minimal counterexample has connected variable-order graph and order at least nine.
factorization_supplement.singleton_convention: Each singleton factor is [1] with one successful word and delta zero; it is not a nonunique counterexample.
factorization_supplement.finite_checks: Independent complete enumeration through order five, plus an empty-matrix implementation boundary; source deterministic examples are not called exhaustive.
